newsitem.title: USA: Smithfield offers to buy Thorn Valley debt.
newsitem.headline: Smithfield offers to buy Thorn Valley debt.

text.p: Smithfield Foods Inc said on Wednesday it offered to buy all the convertible subordinated debentures due 2007 described in a registration statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission by Thorn Apple Valley Inc.
Smithfield said it sent a letter to Thorn's board offering to buy the debt at a 7.25 percent interest rate and a conversion price of $18.25. Thorn has not responded, Smithfield said.

Smithfield said it earlier had offered to buy $15 million principal amount of the debentures, which it said represents the entire amount disclosed in the SEC filing. Smithfield said its new offer was based on market information that the principal amount may be increased.
Thorn shares were up 1-5/8 to 17-1/8 in trading Wednesday. Smithfield was down 3/4 to 36-1/8.
